title: Cloudgate: Cloud Storage Drive
summary: Get 100GB cloud storage space. Backup photo storage videos with data storage app
description:
CloudGate - 100GB Free Storage Cloud Drive App
Get 100GB of free cloud storage space! Backup your photos, videos, File Transfer with a cloud photo free storage app.

Cloudgate is a secure cloud storage app for Android that helps you safely back up and restore your photos, videos, documents, and more. Whether you're switching devices or need extra cloud storage space, Cloudgate provides a reliable online storage solution with easy access across devices.

Key Features of Cloudgate Storage app:

• Free Cloud Storage: Cloud backup app for photos and videos
• Backup & Restore: Restore files to any Android device with one tap
• Secure File Backup: Store contacts, documents, and app data securely
• Free Storage Space: Free 100GB cloud drive storage space on sign-up
• Secure Storage: Secure your important data in Vault lock
• Scan Document: Scan and save receipts, IDs, and documents
• Sync Files: Sync files across devices with secure cloud access
• Easy File Sharing: Share files and folders with friends and family

Why Choose Cloudgate Cloud Drive?

Cloudgate is your cloud drive manager, designed to give you full control of your digital content. It's more than just a cloud storage drive, it's a secure cloud tool that keeps your files safe in cloud drive vault lock and can be accessible anytime.

Easily manage your files with a user-friendly dashboard that works like a smart cloud drive app. Upload, organize, lock, and restore your data from cloud drive all from one place.

How to Use Cloudgate:

1. Sign in to your account

2. Choose what you want to save photos, videos, apps, files

3. Use the secure file drive vault to lock private content

4. Restore or access files anytime

Whether you need more space for media, a backup for important files, or a secure place to scan and store documents, Cloudgate gives you peace of mind with a professional cloud storage solution built for Android users.

Need help? Contact us at support@cloudgate-app.com
